name: Czechia: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or sponsor signatory are left empty, not invented.
Language matches requirements.json language_rules (Czech; K1 Czech or English; insurance Czech or bilingual).

Signature as the Czech rule for that document requires: M1, M2 DoI and N1 signed at submission with a SÚKL-accepted method (handwritten, recognised, qualified or guaranteed electronic, or dynamic biometric; not DocuSign or a non-compliant sponsor-created signature); R1 signed by the sponsor; no signature on K1, K2, L documents.
The mandatory SÚKL national template is used where one exists (Templates No. 1 to 7); an EU form bound as interim content is not uploaded as the Czech document.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json.

CZ-DOC-LIST.check: A machine-readable list of all documentation under review is present (in the cover letter or as a separate file).
Every document's version and date in the list match the uploaded document and its footer.

CZ-K1.check: The current procedure form is used and every Czech national field of SÚKL Template No. 1 is included (EU v2.0 template checked together with Template No. 1).

The yes/no answers for incapacitated adults, minors, impartial witness and emergency match the project's populations and study facts; each 'yes' section is completed, each 'no' section gives the not-applicable answer.

Member State fields carry the Czech rules: Czech PIS/ICF only, certified translation route for foreign nationals, consent by the investigator, signed copy retained and given, SÚKL-accepted electronic signatures.
Minors: SÚKL age bands 12-14 and 15-17 with written information, under-12 information where meaningful, one-parent signature, re-consent at band change and at 18.

Incapacitated adults: consent-giver determined from legal status and court ruling, adapted information, objection respected, two-stage information for acute participants where used, re-consent on regained capacity.
Impartial witness: reason, independent selection outside the study team and procedure described, for participants who cannot write or cannot read.
Emergency: Article 35 conditions, identification and documentation of urgency, later information and consent to continue without undue delay.
Healthy-volunteer recruitment and informed-consent process is described.
Recruitment routes and first act of recruitment match every K2 item and the protocol.

CZ-M1.check: SÚKL Template No. 2 is used (not the EU CV form), completed in Czech, current, one per principal investigator and site.
Dated and signed by the physician with a SÚKL-accepted method.
If GCP training is documented only in the CV: month, year and training provider are stated.
Investigator and site match CTIS, the site list and N1.

CZ-M-GCP.check: The separate GCP certificate is not older than three years and identifies the ICH E6 version covered.

CZ-M2-DOI.check: SÚKL Template No. 3 is used, in Czech, dated and signed by the physician with a SÚKL-accepted method; consistent with the CV and site.

CZ-SITE-LIST.check: Machine-readable list in Czech of all Czech trial sites and principal investigators, matching CTIS.
Czech diacritics and all academic titles preserved.
No lists of sub-investigators or other team members included.

CZ-N1.check: SÚKL Template No. 4 is used (not the EU site-suitability form), one per Czech site, identifying the site name and address.
Signed at submission by the department head, clinic director or principal investigator with a SÚKL-accepted method.
Procedures performed outside the main site are identified with who provides them.

CZ-N-FACILITY.check: Regional Authority evidence confirms healthcare-facility status and the permitted scope of activities for each non-state or non-Ministry site and each sub-site performing part of the trial.

CZ-N-GCP-CERT.check: A scan of the SÚKL GCP certificate is present for each bioequivalence, pharmacokinetic or First-in-Human site that must hold one.

CZ-O1.check: Insurance certificate present, in Czech or bilingual, identifying the trial.
If it states a participant number, the number covers the planned Czech enrolment; an increase is handled by an updated certificate as a non-substantial modification.
Insurer and cover match the participant documents.

CZ-O2.check: Complete insurance policy including the terms and conditions is present (mandatory), in Czech or bilingual.
Cover, exclusions and participant obligations are consistent with the PIS/ICF.

CZ-O-POSTTRIAL.check: Sponsor statement explains how compensation is ensured for health damage that becomes apparent only after the trial and after the policy expires.

CZ-R1.check: SÚKL Template No. 5 is used and signed by the sponsor; a third-country sponsor signs it itself (not an EU representative or CRO).
Uploaded in the Part II data-protection category, even when the same declaration is in Part I under Forms.
Sponsor and controller descriptions match the PIS/ICF.

CZ-S1.check: SÚKL Template No. 7 is used and completed in full.
Covers samples collected during the trial as well as storage and future use, consistent with the protocol, the PIS/ICF and the future-use document.

Future use: storage duration, pseudonymised or fully anonymised status and main research purpose stated; consent structure (separate signature or separate signed document) matches the participant documents.

CZ-P1.check: SÚKL Template No. 6 is used, or the sponsor's document gives references to where every Template No. 6 item is addressed.
Czech information covers expense reimbursement, compensation, any remuneration and the payment method; amounts identical to the participant documents.
Payment cards: no participant fees, Czech-language support and an alternative reimbursement method.
Remuneration limited to Phase I, bioequivalence or pharmacokinetic studies and not for vulnerable participants (KLH-22 recommendation).

CZ-P-FUNDING.check: A description of how the trial will be funded is present under Financial and Other Arrangements.

CZ-FEE.check: No Part II fee paid at the initial submission; payment made only after SÚKL designates the Ethics Committee.

The payment route matches the designated committee (SÚKL Ethics Committee: UST-29 and the applicable K-023 to K-028 code; multicentre Ethics Committee: billing information and that committee's instructions), and evidence is provided within the assessment.

CZ-DEVICE.check: Device or IVD use is identified in the application; applicable conformity documents and Czech instructions for use are present.

Non-CE-marked devices or use outside the intended purpose: additional national declarations and any separate clinical investigation or performance-study authorisation are addressed per the current KLH-CTIS-01 text.
